translation.name: I 'utz laj tzij re i dios

book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: WACH U ʼALIJINSAM I DIOS CHE I SAN JUAN

content: Wach xa ʼiltajic are xrakchʼix i uwuk séllo tzʼapbal re u chiʼ i wuj
Ire, chi ral Chij ca bix che, xu rakchʼij i uwuk séllo; are ʼuri lic xtzʼini chila chicaj; xu chʼij nicʼaj ʼor lic tzʼinilic.
Teʼuri, xe wil i je wukub ángel chi je tacʼal chuwach i Dios. Are ʼuri, xyaʼ wukub trompet chique.

Teʼuri xcʼun jun chic ángel, rucʼam jun porobal inciénso pu ʼab, lic óro. Xol tacʼal chuwach i altar, chi xak lic óro, chi ʼo chuwach i chom laj cubibal. Are ʼuri, qʼui inciénso xyaʼ che, man cu ya puwi i altar junam ruʼ i qui tzʼonbal i creyent, pacha jun sipon chuwach i Dios.
I sib re i inciénso chi ʼo pu ʼab i ángel xel bi chicaj chuwach i Dios, junam ruʼ i qui tzʼonbal i winak chi je re i Dios.

Teʼuri i ángel xu nojsaj i porobal inciénso che i aʼal chi ʼo puwi i altar; y xu jopij bi chuwach i jyub taʼaj. Are ʼuri xtataj u chʼawbal jab, xak juban chic chʼawbal, xak xpe juban u rep ray, y xpe jun nim laj ucabrakan.
Wach xa ʼiltajic are xchʼawsax i wukub trompet
Are ʼuri i je wukub ángel chi yatal wukub trompet chique, xqui yijba quib chu chʼawsaxic.
Teʼuri i nabe ángel xu chʼawsaj u trompet. Are ʼuri xu ticba li tzakic i nimak tak sakbach, xak i ʼaʼ, xak i quicʼ chuwach i jyub taʼaj. Are ʼuri i ulew xu maj ʼaʼ, laj pa nicʼaj
xcʼatic, xak queje i cheʼ, xak i ʼes rax.
Teʼuri i ucab ángel xu chʼawsaj u trompet. Are ʼuri, ʼo pacha jun nim laj jyub ca juluwic xcʼak bi pa mar; laj nicʼaj che i mar xquiqʼuer u wach.
Niʼpa i chicop je cʼas chupam, laj nicʼaj chique xe camic. Xak niʼpa i bárco ʼo puwi, laj pa nicʼaj chique xsach qui wach.

Teʼuri i urox ángel xu chʼawsaj u trompet. Are ʼuri jun nim laj chʼumil xtzak li chuwach i jyub taʼaj, lic ca juluwic pacha chaj. Xtzak puwi laj nicʼaj che tak i ya, xak laj nicʼaj che tak i ralaxbal ya.
I u bi i chʼumil-le, “Cʼa” ca bix che. Laj pa nicʼaj re i tak i ya xoʼon cʼa che, xak i ralaxbal ya. Je qʼui i winak xe cam rumal i ya-le, chi lic cʼa.

Teʼuri i ucaj ángel xu chʼawsaj u trompet. Are ʼuri, xoʼon mal i ʼij; laj pa nicʼaj xoʼon ʼekum che. Xak queje xoʼon che i icʼ, xak che i chʼumil; laj pa nicʼaj xu sach u wach qui tzunbal. Rumal ʼuri, laj pa nicʼaj re i paʼij n-xoʼon ta sak, xak queje xoʼon che i chaʼab, man n-ta kas u tzunbal i icʼ, i chʼumil.

Teʼuri xin taken chicaj, y xin ta u chʼawbal jun ángel chi ca rupup chicaj. Are ʼuri ire xsiqʼuin chu bixquil: —¡Ay! ¡Toʼ qui wach ique chi je re u wach i jyub taʼaj! ¡Toʼ qui wach ique are quiqui chʼawsaj qui trompet i oxib chic ángel! ¡Lic toʼ qui wach ique! —xu bij.

footnotes.text: I jyub taʼaj, we ta ʼo oxib tant che, jun che i oxib tant xcʼatic.
